B_choice.rule: highest IS $/day with IS >= 8 %/yr on locked capital; ties to fewer rungs

C_choice.rule: highest IS $/day for the chosen set whose busiest day of the 28 stays under 600 POSTs

D_choice.rule: the fastest cadence unless a slower one beats it on IS by more than 5 %

paired_same_timing_and_cap.what: variant against the frozen rungs and step at the variant's cadence and cap

recommended.rule: the account count whose best configuration has the highest IS $/day; within 5 %, fewer accounts
